reviews.review_description: The torso on my avatar is off center at an irritating angle and is in my way. Other than that my only other complaint is that some of the parts on the tasks shoot off at a random angle or off the model. Keep up the good work! i cannot wait to see what this game becomes. i already pre-ordered the full release

this game is awesome! it brings the greatness of building your own vehicles and mechs to virtual reality. You can create awesome builds and even customize your avatar. Sadly, it seems as is the other reviews are trashing on the game since another game came out like this and they are trying to bring it down. This is a great game and i cant wait for the full release!
